title: Running a Simulation with metaRVM
text: MetaRVM supports measles alongside flu. key differences configuration : model: disease: measles — selects measles engine. vaccination file — vaccinated individuals seeded via V10 (one-dose) V20 (two-dose) columns population CSV. time-varying vaccination schedule. Different disease parameters — beta, de1, de2, di1, di2, prop_I1_Q, prop_I2_Q, V1_eff, V2_eff. Different compartments — two-stage latent (E1→E2), two-stage infectious (I1→I2) quarantined/unquarantined splits, plus vaccinated breakthrough chains (V1, V2, V1E1, …). packaged measles example can run directly: subset_data() method works way measles. text: MetaRVM implements stratified metapopulation models demographic subgroup set compartments disease progression. simulations stochastic. Transmission stratified user-defined demographic groups (e.g., age, zone, race). Time-varying mixing matrices define strata interact (daytime vs. nighttime, weekday vs. weekend), MetaRVM computes stratum-specific forces infection. title: Build a MetaRVM configuration — build_config
text: disease Character. Disease simulate. Supported values: "flu", "measles". vaccination mechanism differs disease: flu reads time-varying schedule vaccination CSV argument; measles encodes vaccination initial compartment counts (V10, V20) directly population CSV — separate vaccination file used. population_init Character. Path population initialization CSV. mixing_matrices Named list paths mixing-matrix CSV files. Required keys: weekday_day, weekday_night, weekend_day, weekend_night. disease_params Named list disease parameters. element may scalar, per-population vector, distribution-spec list list(dist = "lognormal", mu = -0.7, sd = 0.1). start_date Character ("MM/DD/YYYY") Date. Simulation start date. sim_length Positive integer. Number days simulate. nsim Positive integer. Number parameter draws (default 1). nrep Positive integer. Replicates per parameter draw (default 1). run_id Optional character identifier stored run metadata. Auto-generated current timestamp NULL. vaccination Optional character. Path vaccination schedule CSV. Used flu ; ignored measles (encodes vaccination V10/V20 columns population CSV). sub_disease_params Optional named list per-category parameter overrides. Structure mirrors sub_disease_params: YAML section, e.g. list(age = list(child = list(ts = 0.6))). Values can also distribution specs, e.g. list(dist = "lognormal", mu = 2, sd = 0.5), drawn independently per simulation replicate way disease_params distributions . random_seed Optional integer seed reproducibility. Auto-generated NULL. delta_t Numeric time-step days. Defaults 0.5 NULL. parallel Logical. Whether metaRVM() may use parallel foreach backend. Default FALSE. Set TRUE top-level call; leave FALSE config used inside parallel worker prevent nested-parallel conflicts. checkpoint_dir Optional character. Directory checkpoint files. Supported flu measles. checkpoint_dates Optional character vector dates ("MM/DD/YYYY") write checkpoints. Supported flu measles. restore_from Optional character. Path checkpoint .Rda file restore . Supported flu measles. output_file Optional character. provided configuration written path YAML file. Paths inside config stored absolute paths file self-contained regardless working directory. return_object Logical. TRUE configuration parsed returned MetaRVMConfig object. FALSE (default) raw configuration list returned (invisibly output_file also given). verbose Logical. Passed parse_config() return_object = TRUE. suppress_odin_messages Logical. Passed parse_config() return_object = TRUE.

text: function processes YAML configuration file following main sections: Model Selection: model.disease: Required. Selects disease simulate; supported values "flu" "measles". disease choice determines disease parameters expected, population initialization CSV column schema, whether vaccination schedule file used (flu ; see ). Simulation Configuration: random_seed: Optional random seed reproducibility case stochastic simulations stochastic parameters nsim: Number simulation instances (default: 1) nrep: Number stochastic replicates per parameter set (default: 1) #' start_date: Simulation start date MM/DD/YYYY format length: Simulation length days checkpoint_dir: Optional checkpoint directory saving intermediate results checkpoint_dates: Optional list dates save checkpoints. restore_from: Optional path restore simulation checkpoint Population Data: required initialization CSV columns disease-specific; additional columns treated demographic categories. Flu: population_id, N, S0, I0, V0, R0 (optional: E0, Ia0, Ip0, H0, D0, defaulted 0 absent). Flu — first column must dates MM/DD/YYYY format, rest columns must correspond respective subpopulations numeric order population_id. Supported values: "flu", "measles". Configs without field produce informative error listing valid options. Renamed internal disease identifier "rvm" "flu". title: MetaRVM 2.1.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-03-26 Added simulation_mode (deterministic/stochastic) nrep support configuration parsing run metadata. Improved stochastic reproducibility: provided random_seed honored, seed generated/stored missing. Updated stochastic transition splitting use binomial draws integer compartment flows (n_EIpresymp, n_IsympH, n_HR). Improved metapopulation infection-flow indexing consistency destination- specific force infection n_SE_eff n_VE_eff. Added bounded vaccination transition safeguards reduce overdraw risks (example, capping applied vaccination available susceptible count guarding zero effective population force--infection calculations). Added integer row allocation stochastic mixing flows (S V) using floor-plus-residual adjustment row totals conserved. Added regression tests stochastic seed behavior, nsim * nrep instance counts, row-allocation conservation checks S/V mixing. Enhanced results helper APIs: MetaRVMResults$plot() now provides direct trajectory plotting summarization. MetaRVMSummary$plot() now supports instance-trajectory plotting. summarize() uses efficient single-pass grouped aggregation.
